[[Category:Senate]] [[Category:Senate Sessions]] [[Category:388YE Summer]]
==Overview==
The [[Senate]] governs the Empire, and its authority extends to all areas of Imperial life not already covered by the other houses of government. Each summit the [[senator|senators]] meet [[Event schedule|several times]] to deliberate and vote on the [[Senate motion|motions]] they have raised. 

After the summit, the civil service enacts those motions and ensures a public record of each is made available to the citizens of the Empire. This page lists all the motions raised during the summit, along with the [[Senate announcement|announcements]] made by citizens with [[Imperial title|Imperial titles]]. In each case, the motion and its effects are summarised, including the wording, who proposed and seconded it, whether it passed or not, whether any funds were disbursed to support it, and what the outcome of the motion will be.

Many motions (especially the [[commission|commissions]]) also have a ''Further Details'' section that provides a link to a wiki page dealing specifically with that motion in more detail, any commentary from the [[Scrutiny|Constitutional Court]], progress on commissions, or expanded information about the outcome of the motion.

==Treasury==

==Administrative Motions==

===Amend Master of Works===
*'''Motion:''' To amend the Master of Works to be able to commission one fortification and separately to upgrade one fortification each season
*'''Raised by:''' Speaker of the Senate at the Friday session
*'''Outcome:''' Failed
*'''Note:''' The [[388YE_Spring_Equinox_Senate_sessions#Amend_Master_of_Works|amendment last season]] was unclear about whether Master of Works could make two separate commission announcements in a single season. If this motion is passed, they will be able to build a new fort and upgrade a fort, using two of the Senate's limited commissions. If it fails, the Master of Works will be able to either build a new fort or upgrade an existing one, but not both.

===Appraise the Artisans Guild===
*'''Motion:''' The Throne uses her power of appraisal to set the civil service to appraise the consequences of the Imperial Sodality "Imperial Artisans Guild" sodality manifesto. It holds the following to be true: Imperial artisans are the finest in the world, deserving commensurate respect, recompense and pride; Artisans and the magic items they create are valuable strategic resources for the Empire; The voice of the Empire's artisans should be preeminent in all matters relating to artisanry. The sodality therefore exists to: Guide, aid, and provide consultation to the Empire's artisans, bodies of state and wider citizenry on the matter of artisanry; Support and coordinate artisans in the study, innovation, and creation of magic items; Represent the Empire's artisans, seeking and supporting opportunities within the Empire's borders and beyond.
*'''Announced by:''' Emperor Vesna Borkovna Prochnost, [[the Throne]]
*'''Outcome:''' The results of this appraisal will be presented before the Autumn Equinox 388YE

===Construct Wyrding Tower===
*'''Announcement:''' I commission the Wyrding Tower, a volhov tower proposed in an appraisal by Graciana i Lopez i Guerra. The Vale of the Verdant Promise will bring prosperity to the ruins left by the Cold Sun and will fund this ministry
*'''Announced by:''' Borys Vardovich Straskovich, [[Boyar of the Iron Roads]] at the Sunday afternoon session
*'''Outcome:''' Constructs a [[ministry]] in Livardz, Volodmartz
*'''Further Details:''' [[Construct Wyrding Tower]]
*'''Notes:''' The Wyrding Tower was [[Sunrise_over_Livardz#The_Wyrding_Pond|proposed]] as part of a larger appraisal by Graciana i Lopez i Guerra into finding ways to bring Prosperity to the ruins of Volodmartz left by the ''scions'' of [[Cold Sun]]

==Announcements==
===Research Life of Sjördeyr===
*'''Announcement:''' The Assembly of Loyalty have made their Highest Calling the transformation of Asavea. Our sibling in virtue is the Sumaah Republic are willing to discuss a figure of their past involved in their own liberation. A recruit, an inspiration, a builder. Virtuous action leads to further Virtue and we can learn from the example of Sjördeyr. I invite the High House of Prosperity to work alongside my librarians and share in Virtue.
*'''Announced by:''' Hazelelponi, [[Lepidean Librarian]] at the Friday evening session
*'''Outcome:''' Historical Research on the matter will be delivered to the Lepidean Librarian at the Autumn Equinox 388YE

===Hand of the Chancellor===
* '''Announcement:''' Use of Hand of the Chancellor
* '''Announced by:''' Vesna Borkovna Prochnost, [[The Throne]] at the Friday evening session 
* '''Outcome:''' 249 thrones disbursed to Emperor Vesna Borkovna Prochnost

===Assign the Guerdon===
*'''Announcement:''' The Burning Falcon, the Citadel Guard, and the Eastern Sky to receive the Guerdon
* '''Announced by:''' Natalia 'The Falcon' Barossa, [[Quartermaster General of the Imperial Armies]] at the Sunday afternoon session
* '''Outcome:''' Military units supporting the three armies will receive shares in the [[Military_unit#Imperial_Guerdon|Imperial Guerdon]]

===Assign Regalia to Keeper of the Study===
* '''Announcement:''' To assign the artefact The Mask of the Mourn to the title of the Keeper of the Study. The mask's purpose is to support landskeepers in ritual casting on farms in the Marches - the same responsibility as the Keeper holds. The mask bears a true, spontaneous, Prosperity aura.
* '''Announced by:''' Cilicia of Athiliah's Handiwork, [[Benefactor of Regalia]] at the Saturday afternoon session
* '''Outcome:''' The [[Keeper of the Study]] has been amended

===Refine Dancer's Rest===
*'''Motion:''' We ask the Songbirds to improve the <u>Dancer's Rest</u> in Miaren. We request that the artists cover the walls and surrounding environment of Dancer's Rest with inspirational art which may be added to and developed by anyone who visits. The art should depict Virtuous symbols, inspirational figures, as well as allotting space for those who visit Dancer's Rest to share their experience. Ideally, the artworks begun this season will continue to develop and grow. Art should educate, inspire, and heal.
*'''Announced by:''' Ralphine, [[Maestro of the Cat's Graces]] at the Saturday evening session
*'''Outcome:''' [[Cat%27s_Graces#Refine_Commission|Refines]] the [[Hand to the Dance|Dancer's Rest]] in Serenael, Miaren.

===Research Dauntless Light Chapter===
*'''Announcement:''' The Department sends Octavia to research into Rebekah and Abishek of the Dauntless Light chapter and their conflict with the Child of Faithless Grief in the post-patrician era of Highguard
*'''Announced by:''' Watt of Lambrook, [[Minister of Historical Research]] at the Sunday afternoon session
*'''Outcome:''' Historical Research on the matter will be delivered to the Minister at the Summer Solstice 388YE

===Assess Arch of the Sky===
*'''Announcement:''' As Architect of the Hammers, I invite the "Architects of Iron and Stone" to assess the Arch of the Sky in how it may be improved
*'''Announced by:''' Edmundo of Damakan's forge, [[Architect of Hammers]] at the Sunday afternoon session

===Reappraise Blades of the Semmerlak===
*'''Announcement:''' I request that the prognosticators review the opportunity to build the Blades of the Semmerlak, originally offered in Spring 386
* '''Announced by:''' Tristan Ramson von Holberg, [[Master of the Mint]] at the Sunday afternoon session
* '''Outcome:''' The [[Less_welcome_tenants#Blades_of_the_Semmerlak|Blades of the Semmerlak]] was first offered shortly before the Summer Solstice 386YE. The results of this announcement will be made available before the Autumn Equinox 388YE

===Embargo Zemelslo===
*'''Announcement:''' Change the trade status of Zemelslo to embargo
* '''Announced by:''' Slawomir Rabovich Bolotstrazh, [[Imperial Consul]] at the Sunday afternoon session
* '''Outcome:''' An embargo on goods from Zemelslo has been put in place. Zemelslo has responded in kind, and the port of Radosmo is no longer available to Imperial fleets
